title: “Intimacy with God doesn’t just protect you… it makes darkness flee.
paragraphs:
“Intimacy with God doesn’t just protect you… it makes darkness flee.
You don’t win by image — you win by nearness to the King.”
Romans 16:20 — “The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet.”
🔥 If this spoke to you… share it. Someone needs this reminder today.
